biography.value:
Description

The legendary dragon of the divine and holy has returned but with greater power. The magician dragon of the divine and healing art making her quite a vicious foe.

Defense

AC 35, touch 14, flat-footed (+21 natural, +12 dex, -8 size)

hp 841 [1160] (29d12+232)

mp 323

Fort +26, Ref +28, Will +31

Absorb Holy; DR 20/magic;

Immune Ability Drain, Berserk, Blind, Charmed, Confuse, Cowering, Death, Diseased, Doom, Energy Drain, Entangled, Exhausted, Fatigued, Fear, Frightened, Frog, Immobilized, Imperil, Mini, Nauseated, Panicked, Paralysis, Petrify, Poison, Sap, Shaken, Silence, Sleep, Slow, Staggered, Stop, Stunned, Zombie;

SR 34;

Offense

Speed 60 ft., fly 250 ft. (Clumsy)

Melee Bite +39 (4d8+27 plus 3d6 holy damage), 2 claws +39 (3d8+18 plus 2d6 holy damage), 2 Wings +37 (2d8+9 plus 2d6 holy damage), tail slap +37 (3d8+27 plus 2d6 holy damage)

Space 30 ft.; Reach 20 ft.

Special Attacks Breath Weapon (70-ft. cone, 24d10 holy damage, Reflex DC 32 half, usable every 1d4 rounds), Crush (Large creatures, DC 32, 4d8+27), Tail Sweep (Medium creatures, DC 32, 3d8+27)

Burst Mode Heavenly Protection

Spells Known (FC CL 29th, concentration +42)

0th (DC 23) - Dancing Light, Holy Orb, Purify Food and Drink, Read Magic

1st (DC 24) - Dia, Light

2nd (DC 25) - Dia II, Elemental Resistance, Light II

3rd (DC 26) - Dia III, Dispel, Light III, Lightra, Searing Light

4th (DC 27) - Diara, Holy, Light IV

5th (DC 28) - Bright, Diaga, Holy Light, Lightga

6th (DC 29) - Greater Dispel, Holy II, Radiance

7th (DC 30) - Bright II

8th (DC 31) - Holy III, Holy Burst, Radiance II

9th (DC 32) - Saintly Beam

Statistics

Str 46, Dex 34, Con 26, Int 24, Wis 36, Cha 28

Base Atk +29; CMB +47; CMD 69 (73 vs. trip)

Feats Chain Spell, Combat Casting, Destructive Dispel, Empower Spell, Extend Spell, Extra MP, Greater Fortitude, Hover, Improved Initiative, Iron Will, Piercing Spell, Quicken Spell, Spell Penetration, Spell Perfection (Holy II), Widen Spell

Skills Acrobatics +41, Appraise +40, Bluff +41, Diplomacy +41, Fly +25, Knowledge (arcana) +40, Knowledge (history) +40, Knowledge (local) +40, Knowledge (nobility) +40, Perception +46, Sense Motive +46, Spellcraft +40, Use Magic Device +40

Languages Common, Draconic, Enochian

SQ Divine Casting, Guardian Angel
